current_date: Updated June 2024 and adopted August 2024 following consultation
current_evidence: The 'Planning application validation' section of threerivers.gov.uk/services/planning/planning-applications links this PDF as the Validation Checklist, its cover says 'Updated June 2024 and adopted August 2024 following consultation', and a search found no newer checklist or consultation.

issues.detail: Householder, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent and Lawful development cert are all shown as '(none) - national requirements only', but the checklist applies local requirements to them. The Part D Biodiversity Checklist 'must be completed and submitted with all applications'. CIL Additional Questions Form 1 is required with ALL planning applications. A Streetscene elevation is required for extensions to dwellings that raise the ridge height. A Heritage Statement is required for works needing Listed Building Consent. A Notice of Chargeable Development is required for all certificate of lawfulness applications. A Tree Survey is required where the site is subject to a TPO, is in a Conservation Area, or has trees over 75mm diameter.
issues.evidence: Part B item 1: Part D 'must be completed and submitted with all applications'; item 4: 'all extensions to dwellings involving a raise in ridge height'; item 5: Form 1 'must be submitted with ALL planning applications'; Part C matrix has Householder, LBC, Advert and CLU columns.

issues.detail: Local requirements not captured: Land Contamination Assessment (item 13: preliminary risk assessment on sites that have or are suspected to have contamination, or for potentially contaminating uses in sensitive areas); Notice of Chargeable Development for all certificates of lawfulness; Chorleywood Neighbourhood Plan extras (EV charging statement for 10+ dwellings; landscape strategy for all major applications); FRA for any basement in the Moor Park Conservation Area; Thames Water capacity confirmation for major applications; refuse vehicle access details for all new developments.
issues.evidence: Item 13: 'A preliminary risk assessment may be required on sites which have or are suspected to have contamination'; item 18: Moor Park Conservation Area Appraisal requires an FRA for basement proposals; item 11: Chorleywood Plan EV charging statement for 10 or more dwellings.

issues.detail: The 'Schedule of works (listed building)' row has an unrelated trigger: 'an Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan (TPP).' The checklist has no local schedule-of-works requirement; this tree text belongs to item 9 (Tree Survey and Report).
issues.evidence: Part B item 9 Tree Survey and Report covers the AMS/TPP; no schedule-of-works item exists in Part B.

issues.detail: Many triggers miss the actual threshold. Transport ('GFA Where a Transport Statement is required...') omits TS for 50-80 residential units and TA for over 80 units, plus the floorspace bands. Drainage/SuDS omits 'all developments of 10 dwellings or more and all major commercial developments'. Affordable Housing just says 'see section 7 below' instead of 'where affordable housing is to be provided on-site'. Arboricultural omits TPO / Conservation Area / trees over 75mm. Fire Statement is cut off ('more storeys...') and omits 'two or more dwellings and 18m or 7+ storeys'. BNG gives only 'metric should show a net positive score' and omits the trigger (major development from 12 Feb 2024, small sites from 2 Apr 2024). Heritage gives contents ('As a guide a Heritage Statement must...') not the trigger. Photographs includes stray 'TABLE 2 Sites recognised for their biodiversity importance'.
issues.evidence: Item 19: SuDS for 'all developments of 10 dwellings or more and all major commercial developments'; item 20: relevant building 'Contains two or more dwellings or educational accommodation and' 18m+/7+ storeys.

issues.detail: The 'Self-build / custom build information' row is marked 'Application type named in requirement text' but its trigger is the CIL Form 7 self-build exemption claim (a CIL relief form submitted after completion), not a validation requirement. The 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' row quotes the site/block plan definition ('public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking...'), not a highways requirement.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'CIL Form 7 - Self build exemption claim Form (part 1) Please note that within 6 months of completion...'

issues.detail: The Energy / Sustainability Statement is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' using web-page text about 'change of use' planning applications. Prior approval is not mentioned; the checklist (item 8) ties the statement to new residential development of one unit and above and all new commercial development.
issues.evidence: Item 8: required for 'new residential development of one unit and above' and all new commercial development; the page excerpt is about full change-of-use applications over 500 sqm.

issues.detail: About 25 rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' although the checklist has a Part C matrix by application/development type (Householder, Replacement dwellings, New residential <=9 / 10+, Change of use, Conversion, Commercial <1000 / >1000 sqm, CLU, LBC, Advert, Outline). For example, the Biodiversity Checklist and CIL form (all applications) and Affordable Housing (explicitly required in indicative form for outline) appear only under Full planning.
issues.evidence: Item 7: indicative affordable housing details are still needed for outline applications; Part C column headings.

issues.detail: Most of the 18 'Submission rules' tab items are not validation requirements. They are contact details (dc.online@threerivers.gov.uk, enquiries@ email), complaints/Ombudsman and performance report text, Natural England invoicing text, 'We reviewed the evidence related to policy CP4 in July 2025', and CIL page boilerplate (Charging Schedule, rates for 2026, Instalments Policy, Regulation 123 List, assumption/withdrawal/transfer of liability forms) taken from the separate CIL web page.
issues.evidence: Tab items sourced from threerivers.gov.uk/services/planning/community-infrastructure-levy and the planning-applications page.

issues.detail: The 'Policy-driven requirements' tab item is a garbled fragment of the biodiversity checklist table (bullet characters, '* a full list of Priority Habitats (Habitats of Principal Import'), not a requirement. The 'Local forms' item is an all-caps instruction line rather than the requirement itself.
issues.evidence: 'Proposals on or adjacent to a nonstatutory designated site ▪ ▪ Other Priority Habitat ▪ Hedgerow Regs ...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Three Rivers Validation Checklist (adopted August 2024), and the main topics are captured. However, it wrongly shows Householder, LBC, Advert and LDC as having no local requirements, misses Land Contamination and several area-specific triggers, has a mismatched 'Schedule of works' row and many threshold-less triggers, and fills the tab with CIL and contact boilerplate.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
